description: §41.12 — a function-valued `registerMessages` entry (the pre-S462 form `.Required: (field) => …`) is refused with E-MESSAGE-NOT-TEMPLATE. A registered message is a message template — a string with named slots — and the diagnostic shows that form.
rationale: S462 ruling (user-voice-scrml.md S462 "go on the package", item 2, a consequence of "no value holds a function", §14.3 extended): registerMessages values become message templates, not functions. §41.12: a value that is a function SHALL be refused with E-MESSAGE-NOT-TEMPLATE.
